facts: Enron describes itself as a laboratory of innovation that employs open markets to lower prices and drive innovation.
The company states that its success is measured by the success of its customers and focuses on long-term partnerships.
Enron claims to operate safely with concern for the environment across the various places it operates globally.
The corporate text emphasizes values including diversity, respect, integrity, communication, and excellence.
The page carries a copyright notice for Enron Corp. covering the years 1997 through 2000.
